compatibility_changes: HyperFrames v0.8.34 documents paused Studio and runtime previews as idle: paused playback should stop scheduling/redrawing work instead of continuously consuming CPU. reCast Studio already cancels requestAnimationFrame on pause; its independent runtime remains the compatibility implementation.

HyperFrames v0.8.34 fixes Studio layer-following during drag and preview scene isolation at the playhead, including correct audio-track selection while scrubbing. reCast keeps its independent scene selection and seek messaging contract; no upstream implementation code is copied.

HyperFrames v0.8.34 resolves media clip starts once for playback, manifest, visibility, and audio scheduling. reCast already exposes the independent pure resolveMediaStart contract so nested media can share one coordinate rule.

HyperFrames v0.8.34 hardens rendering and capture: retry browser initialization once, reject malformed JPEG inputs, verify Chrome execution during preflight, validate image/font/Lottie downloads, validate redirect targets, preserve existing cloud output on failed downloads, and restrict localhost render aliases. reCast independently retries Chromium initialization and validates render dimensions, frame counts, and output artifacts; unsupported upstream-specific downloader surfaces are not copied.

HyperFrames v0.8.34 and its security fixes authenticate runtime, Studio preview, slideshow, and registry message senders. reCast independently accepts seek control only from its mounted preview frame.

HyperFrames v0.8.34 adds CDN script integrity verification and stronger project/generated-asset path containment. reCast does not inline remote scripts or expose the corresponding Studio project filesystem, so no unsupported API was added.

HyperFrames v0.8.34 adds registry installation bounds and hosted-asset behavior plus carousel catalog content. reCast has no registry/catalog installer surface, so those behaviors remain documented rather than copied.

HyperFrames main after v0.8.34 adds the core lint rule unclosed_tag_swallowed_element for a start tag whose unquoted attribute text contains a '<' and therefore swallows a following element. reCast now independently exposes hasUnquotedLessThan() and detectSwallowedElement() from @recast/core with matching finding code/severity semantics.
HyperFrames main after v0.8.34 improves doctor diagnostics when HYPERFRAMES_PYTHON is rejected. reCast has no equivalent Python override or TTS/BGM subsystem, so no incompatible CLI option was added.
The compatibility implementation mirrors documented behavior and interfaces only; no upstream implementation code is copied.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
